standard-dialogue.player: Hello Ambassador. Are you here visiting King Roald?

standard-dialogue.npc: Well, in theory, but he always seems to be busy.

standard-dialogue.player: You don't seem that upset by that, though...

standard-dialogue.npc: Oh no, I like travelling, and if you become a diplomat patience is a vital skill.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player doesn't have the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has a premade item in their inventory:

steps.text: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Ambassador Ferrnook

steps.npc: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.

steps.text: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
If the player does not have a reward token available:
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
If the player does have a reward token available:
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
If the player has an unclaimed reward token:
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
If the player has claimed their reward token:

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player ran out of time:

steps.text: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
